title: Version-pinned x86-64 decoding and semantics
statement: Implement the book's exact x86-64 teaching slice as decoded instruction instances and checked state transformations, including selected flags, register and memory operand forms, partial-register behavior where admitted, and differential mutation controls.
notes: The current AVX2 synthesizers implement restricted shuffle-family semantics for particular searches. They are not an x86-64 decoder or general scalar semantics layer.
